messages:
jamie_support: Heads-up — ACME says their March invoice jumped 18% overnight. They supplied request ids req_83a7, req_83a8. Dashboard shows token counts doubled for the 14:12 window. Suspect retries or header loss at the edge.

mike_sre: Can you paste one raw request id + the client timestamp they sent?

jamie_support: req_83a7 — customer log: client_ts=2026-03-10T14:12:07Z. Our ledger has two writes: 2026-03-10T14:12:07.000Z and 2026-03-10T14:12:07.250Z. App logs show only one client-side send.

luca_eng: Could be edge proxy clock skew + header rewrite. If the idempotency header gets stripped on re-forward we’d accept both and bill twice. @mike_sre can you pull proxy trace for tx-9f3a?

mike_sre: Pulling now. I see two identical request hashes within 250ms. trace id tx-9f3a. Snippet from edge logs:

```
edge-01 | 2026-03-10T14:12:07.000Z | tx-9f3a | req_hash=8f3a... | headers={Host: api.redwood, Idempotency-Key: null}
edge-01 | 2026-03-10T14:12:07.250Z | tx-9f3a | req_hash=8f3a... | headers={Host: api.redwood, Idempotency-Key: null}
```

mike_sre: Both forwarded to gateway and gateway accepted them as separate events.

billing_ana: If both reached the model backend and consumed tokens, billing will reflect both. We need to confirm whether the SDK sent an idempotency header and whether the proxy rewrote/ dropped it. Which SDK + version?

jamie_support: Customer is on SDK v2.1.2 — it sets `Idempotency-Key` per request. They also run a custom nginx reverse proxy in front that was updated last week.

priya_devex: I remember a regression where nginx with `proxy_http_version 1.1` + `proxy_set_header Connection ""` could drop some headers on re-forward when chunked requests occur. Quick repro curl: 

```
curl -v -H "Idempotency-Key: abc-123" --data-binary @payload \ 
  -x http://local-nginx:8080 https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```

priya_devex: If nginx strips the header, the gateway sees no idempotency key and will meter each forwarded attempt.

luca_eng: Action: reproduce with their nginx conf and SDK. If header missing on second forward, we have clear duplication. Also add an alert for `ingress.idempotency_missing` so we catch this earlier.

jamie_support: I'm standing up a repro with their conf now — will post outcome. Customer asked for a temporary credit while we investigate.

billing_ana: We can provisionally credit obvious duplicates once SRE confirms pattern. Please include list of affected request hashes and timestamps.

devops-bot: Deploy triggered: edge-proxy v1.7.3-hotfix (#4721) to stop header rewrite. Rolling to cluster-01/02/03. :rocket:

jamie_support: Repro result: with the customer's nginx conf the `Idempotency-Key` is dropped on the proxied chunked request. Confirmed two ledger entries for same req_hash (tx-9f3a) and both consumed model tokens — ledger rows:

```
ledger|2026-03-10T14:12:07.000Z|req_hash=8f3a...|tokens=412
ledger|2026-03-10T14:12:07.250Z|req_hash=8f3a...|tokens=412
```

mike_sre: Root cause confirmed: header-stripping at the upstream proxy. Plan: finish hotfix roll, add test to integration suite to ensure `Idempotency-Key` is preserved through proxying, and run a ledger query to find collisions.

billing_ana: I'll prepare credit flows and draft customer communication. We need a way to query impacted accounts; what's the recommended ledger query?

luca_eng: Use this SQL to find duplicates (same req_hash within 1s window):

```
SELECT req_hash, array_agg(ledger_ts ORDER BY ledger_ts) as hits
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE ledger_ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY req_hash
HAVING count(*) > 1 AND max(ledger_ts)-min(ledger_ts) < interval '1 second';
```

luca_eng: That should give a list we can crosswalk to accounts. Also add a tag when we apply credits so finance can reconcile.

jamie_support: Thanks — filing ticket INC-2345 with ledger rows and repro notes, cc'ing ACME. Will follow up when credits applied.

mike_sre: :thumbsup: mark as high priority for rollback detection and an alert for sudden per-session token spikes.

jamie_support: Closing loop here — patch rolled to all edges, customer credited provisional amount, and we added `ingress.idempotency_missing` metric + alert. Will reopen if more accounts surface.
